claims: C1 outdated information is one of the things the assistant can be uncertain because of: what it knows about the matter is no longer current
C2 one ground on which the assistant's information about a matter counts as outdated is that the matter turns on developments falling after the model's knowledge cutoff
C3 a second, independent ground is that the circumstances bearing on the matter change rapidly, so what the model knows can be stale even inside its knowledge
C4 the two grounds are alternatives, not a conjunction: either one on its own makes the item a case of outdated information
C5 the item classifies a source of uncertainty and attaches no obligation, permission or prohibition to any act

concepts.name: outdated_information_cause
concepts.gloss: the assistant's uncertainty about matter I is of the outdated-information kind: what the model knows bearing on I is no longer current at the time it is asked

concepts.name: beyond_knowledge_cutoff
concepts.gloss: matter I turns on developments dated after the point at which the model's training knowledge stops, so the model was never shown them
concepts.inference: the span names the knowledge cutoff as a cause of outdatedness; for a cutoff to make the information on a particular matter stale, that matter must depend on developments falling on the far side of it, and the span leaves that relation between a matter and the cutoff unnamed

concepts.name: rapidly_changing_circumstances
concepts.gloss: the state of affairs bearing on matter I changes fast enough that what was accurate about it when the model learned it can already have been overtaken
concepts.inference: the span names rapidly changing circumstances as a cause of outdatedness; for rapid change to make the information on a particular matter stale, that matter must be one whose circumstances move at that pace, and the span leaves that relation between a matter and the rate of change unnamed

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the entity the end user or developer is interacting with, the thing this document calls interchangeably the model and the assistant

concepts.name: guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: R is one of the rules stated in the document's #express_uncertainty section, and the rules there carry guideline-level authority: guidance for assistant behavior rather than a strict requirement

ontology.gloss: the assistant's uncertainty about matter I is of the outdated-information kind on the knowledge-cutoff ground: I turns on developments the model's training knowledge stops short of, so what it knows bearing on I is no longer current

the assistant's uncertainty about matter I is of the outdated-information kind on the rapid-change ground: the state of affairs bearing on I moves fast enough that what the model knows about it can already have been overtaken
